Register a likelihood penalty from an rxode2 user-function expansion

Source: R/likPenalty.R
nlmixr2LikPenaltyUdf.Rd

Called from an `rxUdfUi` method while it expands a model term (for example a smoothing spline) against the data. The method must return `uiUseData = TRUE` from its data-free stage, so `nlmixr2()` re-parses the model with the estimation data (`rxode2::rxUdfUiData()`); the specs registered during that re-parse are attached to the expanded model with [nlmixr2LikPenaltyAdd()], so the penalty is active only while that model is estimated. Outside of an nlmixr2 data expansion (for example in `rxSolve()`) the call does nothing. See the "A model term that brings its own penalty" section of `vignette("likelihood-penalties")` and the 'nlmixr2spline' package for a complete example.

Usage

nlmixr2LikPenaltyUdf(spec)

Arguments

spec

a [nlmixr2LikPenaltySpec()] with a unique `name`; a later registration with the same name replaces it

Value

`TRUE` when the penalty was registered, invisibly

Matthew L. Fidler
